    // The signed distance from a point to a cone with its apex at the origin and its
    // axis along +Y, capped by a flat base at height: halfAngle is the angle between
    // the axis and the slanted surface, so the base radius is height * tan(halfAngle).
    // Exact everywhere, including the rim where the side meets the base — which is
    // what makes it longer than the naive version that intersects an infinite cone
    // with a half-space. Precondition: halfAngle lies strictly between zero and a
    // quarter turn; height is positive. (IQ: sdCone.)
    DistanceToCone(p: Point3D, halfAngle: Angle, height: Number): Number {
        var slope = Vector2D(height * halfAngle.Sin / halfAngle.Cos, height.Negative);
        var w = Vector2D(Vector2D(p.X, p.Z).Magnitude, p.Y.Negative);
        var toSide = w - slope * (w.Dot(slope) / slope.LengthSquared).Clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        var toBase = w - Vector2D(slope.X * (w.X / slope.X).Clamp(0.0, 1.0), slope.Y);
        var orientation = slope.Y.Sign.ToNumber;
        var outside = (orientation * (w.X * slope.Y - w.Y * slope.X))
            .Max(orientation * (w.Y - slope.Y));
        return toSide.LengthSquared.Min(toBase.LengthSquared).Sqrt * outside.Sign.ToNumber;
    }
